hook: Brows that last *2 years*, for up to Rs 2 lakh: doctors urge checks
hook_b: Brows that last *2 years*, for up to Rs 2 lakh: doctors urge checks
tldr: Permanent makeup like microbladed brows and lip tints is booming among Hyderabadis in their 20s; doctors warn the needle work carries infection risks.

beats.what: Pigment is pushed into the skin with needles, like a tattoo; results last one to two years depending on technique, pigment and skin.
beats.why: Convenience is driving demand: fewer parlour visits and less daily effort.
beats.care: Doctors say check the artist's training, single-use needles and sterile gloves, and don't pick by Instagram photos alone.

effects.label: Bad results may need laser removal

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Costs range roughly Rs 10,000 to Rs 80,000; some high-end artists charge Rs 1.5-2 lakh.
